subject: Evaluation MAP — Security checkpoints & retention owners
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finpath.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security checkpoint alignment for MAP

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked good. We're assembling the mutual action plan (MAP) internally and want to lock down the security/compliance gates so our procurement and legal teams can move to GRC review. Key asks we have up-front:

- SOC 2: confirmation of scope and the latest SOC 2 type II report (or letter) and date.
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have a completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ export we can intake?
- DPA: draft DPA and any common carveouts, plus preferred retention windows for customer data and logs.
- Evidence ownership: who on Redwood will own uploads for the SOC 2 report, SIG artifacts, and e-discovery requests?

Attached is our baseline security questionnaire (SecurityQuestionnaire_v2.xlsx) — we tried to mark the high-priority fields. Can we get a proposed timeline that lines up the MAP milestones with FinPath's procurement close target (end of July)?

Would love a short call with your security contact this week if possible.

Best,
Elena Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
FinPath

Attachment: SecurityQuestionnaire_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)
From: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint alignment for MAP

Elena — thanks for sending. We're aligned on the MAP approach; below is an initial security-focused slice with owners and proposed dates. I'll host the living MAP doc in Drive and update as we close items.

Proposed MAP security slice (high-level)
- Week 1 (Jun 8–12): Share SOC 2 scope & last report (Owner: Kimberly Park) — deliverable: SOC2-letter.pdf uploaded to shared Drive.
- Week 2 (Jun 14–18): SIG intake & CAIQ export (Owner: Neha Kapoor) — deliverable: SIG-CAIQ.zip + supporting diagrams.
- Week 3 (Jun 21–25): DPA draft + retention appendix (Owner: Legal / Laura Bennett) — deliverable: DPA_Draft_v1.docx + retention table.
- Week 4 (Jun 28–30): Evidence uploads and final acceptance window (Owner: Redwood security + FinPath security) — deliverable: evidence package + signoff slack thread.

Retention notes (initial):
- Customer data: configurable per DPA; default 3 years.
- Audit logs/forensics: recommended 7 years for regulated workflows — we can carve for backups / short-term telemetry to 90 days if needed.

Immediate asks from us:
1) Please confirm the target close date (you mentioned end of July) and any immovable procurement deadlines.
2) Can FinPath share a list of must-have SIG/CAIQ sections that block procurement?

Drive link (MAP draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-Security-Owners
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/finpath/record/FP-2026-82

I'll loop in Kimberly and Neha to own SOC 2/SIG delivery. If you'd like a short sync with our security lead, Kimberly is available Thu (Jun 10) morning PT.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(priyom.das@redwood.ai)

Attachment: MAP-Security-Owners.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint alignment for MAP

Thanks for the outline, Priyom. Quick clarifications from Legal/Security:

- SOC 2 scope: We'll confirm whether RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, and key management are in scope for the current report. If there are specific control IDs FinPath needs evidence for, list them and we'll prioritize.
- SIG vs CAIQ: We typically provide a completed SIG questionnaire and an exported CAIQ JSON for tooling — suggest FinPath highlight blocking sections (encryption at rest, data residency, key management, subcontractors).
- DPA retention carveouts: Laura — on the default retention windows above, can Legal prepare a DPA appendix that supports a 3-year default with options for 7-year retention on logs for high-risk workloads? Also please flag any EU residency language you need.

I'll take ownership of the SOC 2 upload and aim to post a redacted letter by Fri (Jun 11). Neha — want to own CAIQ export and a SIG checklist?

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

From: FinPath Security <security@finpath.com>

Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint alignment for MAP

Hi Priyom / team,

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from the FinPath security review:

- SOC 2: We need either the full SOC 2 type II report (redacted) or an officer attestation letter dated within the last 12 months. A redacted report is preferred for our internal audit.
- SIG/CAIQ: The blocking areas for us are subcontractor disclosures (list of subprocessors), encryption at rest (KMS details), and incident response SLA.
- DPA/retention: Our legal requires a DPA with a retention appendix. FinPath's baseline retention for customer transactional data is 7 years (financial records). For ephemeral telemetry we accept 90 days. Please indicate whether Redwood can support per-customer retention settings (yes/no).
- Evidence uploads: Will Redwood upload artifacts to the shared Drive or provide a secure S3 link? Our GRC prefers Drive with restricted access.

We have a short internal window: procurement approval board meets Jul 26; submission to board must be complete by Jul 20. That gives you a firm deadline to have the MAP security slice closed by Jul 18 to allow legal review.

Attaching our security scope doc for reference.

Thanks,
FinPath Security
security@finpath.com

- DPA draft + retention appendix: Owner: Laura Bennett (Legal) — commit: DPA_Draft_v1 to FinPath for review by Jun 18; include retention options (default 3y, financial records 7y, telemetry 90d) and per-customer retention toggles (Redwood supports configurable retention via account settings).
- Evidence upload path: Owner: Redwood Security (Kimberly) — primary upload to shared Drive folder with restricted permissions; alternate secure S3 link available on request.

Milestones (hard dates to meet FinPath board)

- Jun 16: CAIQ + subprocessors list uploaded (Neha).
- Jun 18: DPA draft to FinPath (Laura).

Open questions / action items

- Both: decide whether a DocuSign DPA signature is required before procurement board submission — FinPath please advise.
